candidateContents.tickets: Release: master commit d05895aea383ea34d1c324532f6b06616a25e012, version 0.0.28; includes DEV-098 (revoke in-repo docx editing; import converts to block document), DEV-099 (xmind editor conventional UI), DEV-100 (sidecar metadata tracked in git), DEV-101 (new Markdown note tree icon).
highlights: DEV-098: in-repo docx editing removed. '新建 DOCX' gone from all create menus; importing a .docx converts it into a native-block .md via the existing docx-markdown conversion, vault stores no .docx bytes; sidecar records sourceDocx/sourceSha256. docx:export (md → docx download) kept. Clicking a stale in-vault .docx shows an unsupported/re-import notice, never auto-converts/deletes. Legacy channels and docx-editor removed.

DEV-099: xmind editor gets conventional editing UI. Floating non-fixed corner groups (left: undo/redo/save-status/save-now; right: zoom-out/percent/zoom-in/fit/reset/theme menu), right drawer on node selection (node ops / shapes / colors / markers / note / hyperlink). Drag plugin enabled; shortcuts Delete, Ctrl/Cmd+Z, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z/Y, Ctrl/Cmd+S; 5 theme presets persisted to sidecar mindmapTheme; marker icons rendered via encoded lucide-style SVGs; node collapse/expand/add-child buttons halved with non-delete-looking chevrons.

DEV-100: .nexnote/metadata sidecars are tracked in git (.nexnote/* + !.nexnote/metadata/ + .nexnote/metadata/*.tmp-*). Fixes cross-device format misclassification where a missing sidecar fell back to native-block and a block-save rewrote the Markdown, hardening the conversion through sync.

DEV-101: a newly created Markdown note shows the Markdown source icon immediately. createNoteIn now optimistically inserts the tree entry with the known format; applyFsChangeEvent merges format instead of dropping a later format-carrying add on the dedup guard.
Release hygiene: all 103 candidate files committed; pre-release typecheck/lint/tests/build/verify-release-config and prettier changed-file gate all green.
